sentences.text:
1. THADIKONDA KOTESHWARA PRASAD Counsel for the Respondent(S):
 1. GP FOR REVENUE (AP)
 2. GP FOR LAND ACQUISITION
The Court made the following ORDER:

The learned counsel for the petitioner is not available even today also, though the matter is listed under the caption "For Dismissal".
Looking into the relief sought for and considering the aspect that there is no interim order for the last nine years
, it appears that the cause in the writ petition does not survive for adjudication.
2. Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed as infructuous.
Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
